title: William H Possible NDE 23177
content: I was admitted to the Navy Hospital via the emergency room for extreme pain and inability to breath due to a saddle pulmonary emboli. This was caused by atrial fibrillation. I experienced an OBE while being worked on by emergency personnel. They were administering oxygen and morphine intravenously while I was in the worst pain that I have ever experienced. In fact, I was being held down while resisting treatment. Suddenly I was floating above and looking down on someone being held down on a stretcher. I had no pain whatsoever. Then, I noticed a fixture on the wall that was an oxygen outlet. I then realized that this was me down there. Just as fast, I was returned to my body and conscious of extreme pain. I had wished that I was back to the floating experience because of the pain and inability to breath.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Massive pulmonary emboli.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: cerning our Earthly lives other than Religion

elements.Anything else?: Yes The best was the out of body experience; the worst was when I returned to my body.
